tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /drag po'i thab bskyed gsang ba spyi'i cho ga nas logs su bkod pa legs par bzhugs/

oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis rlabs/ nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas a mṛ ta/ bzlas shing bsang chu gnas khang dang yo byad kun la gtor/ nang mchod gso ba'i rigs yin na des kyang gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan mang du brjod/ de nas gong bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bsreg rdzas rnams la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya byas pas gtad la/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ lam gsum gyis ma dag pa bkrus par bsam/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ gsum gyis yam shing*/ oṃ shriṃ swāhā/ gsum gyis zhun mar dang*/ oṃ dzriṃ swāhā/ gsum gyis 'bru thams cad dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ gsum gyi rdzas gzhan rnams la byin gyis rlabs par de ku sha nas bzung bsang chu la dmigs te/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ /sa las skye ba'i snying po mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi dag byed 'di/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed shog /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig drag po'i las kyi dngos grub ma lus pa rtsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis me blangs/ sgron me sbar/ oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang chu gtor/ a mṛ ta bzlas bzhin thab la g.yas bskor bya/ oṃ dzwa badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i me sgron thab nang du zhugs/ hūṃ hūṃ zhes bcas brjod cing rlung yab kyis me sbar/ thab khung a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ thab mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung gru gsum nag po sor nyi shu pa kha khyer dmar po la rdo rje phyed pa'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ mu ran sngon po la mtshon cha'i tshogs 'phros pa/ phyi rol thams cad du ye shes kyi me kha dog sna lnga 'bar bas phyed dpangs su yod pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par 'gyur/ thab kyi dbus su paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ yongs su gyur pa las me'i 'khor lo gru gsum pa'i steng du/

'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ padma āḥ'i mtshan pa/ rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo me shin tu drag cing khro ba 'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed pa/ skra khams pa gyen du 'khyil ba/ 'od brgya stong du mas brgyan pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal gnag g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na spyi blug gsum pa na skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gnyis pa na dbyug gu/ gsum pa nas bgrang 'phreng bsnam par bsgom/ gnyis pa spyan drangs pa ni/ lag pa dgang gzar dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa blug gzar dang dril bu bzung la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho mtshams nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te byon par 'gyur/ dbyug gi rtse gsum gyis phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'bar pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ṭakki ni hūṃ dzaḥ oṃ e hya hi mahā shuddhe pa ri shuddhe satwa a ma la hu de rasmi sa ni he do bha wa kro dha agne ma ma ma sha truṃ ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes thab khung ji lta ba bzhin bskyed pa'i g.yas g.yon du bzhag la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ gsum pa ni lag pa gnyis thal mo sprad mthe'u chung srin lag gis rtser btsug la/ oṃ agne ya sa ma ye st+waṃ/ zhes pa'i dam tshig las mi 'da' bar bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ me lha 'dir ni byon pa legs/ / bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gis phul pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ agne ya arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ dgang blug gis arghaṃ 'bul lo/ / ji ltar bltams pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /lha 'i rgyal po khrus gsol ltar/ /lha 'i chu ni dag pa yis/ /bdag gis khyod la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ agne ya pra wa ra sad ka ra pra tītstsha swāhā/

bdag dang 'gro la nas de srid drang srong bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ agne ya padma ka ma st+waṃ/ zhes pas me tog gdan 'bul te thab kyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol/ lnga pa ni mar dgang blug gsum phul te/ mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ agne ya de ba ta dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ zhes pa zhal du phul la gzhan bsreg rdzas gcig tu 'gres te/ bsreg rdzas dgra bo'i sha khrag tu bsam te 'bul bar bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ oṃ oṃ agne ya de ba ta/ zhes pa la rnam lnga btags la 'bul bar bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍakki dbang bskur pa/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ ces pas bstod/ oṃ badzra a na la mahā bhu ta dzwa la dzwa la sarba bhasmi ku ru duṣta na hūṃ phaṭa/ dri shya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya staṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis dam la bzhag me lha'i thugs kar hūṃ ljags las rdo rje rtse gcig pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa dgang blug gi kha la yang hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ agne ya a ti bya a ti bya/ a bi sha a bi sha mahā shri ya ha bya ka bya wa ha na ya/ bdag gis sdig sgrib bar chad nad gdon bkra mi shis pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis dgang blug 'bul/ de bzhin du sngags de nyid kyis yaṃ shing lan gsum phul/ slar yang sngags de nyid ji ltar 'os pa'i sreg rdzas thams cad la bsres de nas ci rigs par 'bul lo/ / oṃ agne ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i mar blugs gzar gang thab tu phul/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /me lha de nyid 'od du zhu nas 'bar ba me'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar yang bsangs sbyangs/ 'bar ba me'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum zhes pa nas/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/

ces pa nas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes pa'i bar bsgrub thabs bzhin no/ /snying po'i sngags kho na bsregs par byed pa nyid la ci tsam dgos pa'i grangs 'dzin pa nyid bzang po yin no/ /sreg rdzas rdzogs pa'i mthar so so'i mngon rtogs nas byung ba'i gtor 'bul mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams byas la/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛta/ sogs nas/ chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥlha thams cad kyi ljags nas shog oṃ ind+ra nas shog oṃ kā la ru pa nas shog oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥbadzra ṭākki ni nas stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrī phaiṃ badzra a rall̥ nas shog ces pa'i bar ro/ /de nas gzhung gi mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ka pa la yangs shing nas do nub khyod kyis bskrad par gyis/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod yon nas oṃ shrī badzra bai ra wa nas arghaṃ nas shabta 'i bar gyis mchod la/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po nas mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ nas 'dud nyi shu'i bar gyis bstod la/ gsol gdab yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /oṃ khyod kyi sems can zhes pa'am/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa'ang stsol/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas gshegs badzra muḥ oṃ dza ya dza ya/

sogs gzhung la 'jug go /ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ nas lte bar saṃ rnams kyis rgyas gdab par gyur/ kun rtog gzung 'dzin/ sogs rang gi snying gar bsdu/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /me lha de nyid sngar gyi rnam pa ci lta ba bzhin du gyur/ oṃ agne ye swāhā/ ces pa'i bar mar dgang blugs gang du phul/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyi mchod pa gong bzhin 'bul/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung ba yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thab kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghandhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba rnyes kyang thugs rjes che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal ces pas bstod/ me lha'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ.oṃ agne ya a ti bhya nas wa ha na ya oṃ a kā ro lan bdun gyis/ gtor ma phul/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gis 'phrin las gzhol/ mchod yon nas gong bzhin phul/ bstod pa bya/ gang yang bdag blo nas bzod par gsol/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/

/ji bzhin dus su tshur byon cing*/ /bdag gis dngos grub thams cad bsgrub/ /oṃ āḥbadzra muḥ ye shes kyi me lha de nyid rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba me'i nang du thim par gyur/ bkra shis dang smon lam ci 'grub bya'o/ /me rang bzhin gyi zhu bar ma 'gyur gyi bar du dkrug par mi bya'o/ /glo bur las rjes bsdu dgos pa byung na 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chu la/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru/ nas sa dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa'i brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas me la blug rgyas pa la sogs pa gzhan rnams la yang cho ga 'di rigs 'grel/ lha nyung ngu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ cho ga bsdus pa'i rigs dang bsgrub thabs phra mo sogs la de dang 'brel bar mdor bsdu 'di tsam kho na legs shing gzhan gong ma ltar la/ dngos gzhi'i skabs rdzas sngags so so byed pa bor ba ni shin tu bsdus pa'i rigs su gtogs so/ /gsang ba spyi'i cho ga nas drag po thabs bskyed logs su bkol ba'o/ /gsang ba spyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdo tsam 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //dge legs maṅga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ drag po'i thab bskyed gsang ba spyi'i cho ga nas logs su bkod pa legs par bzhugs/ - PAGE 266 -- PAGE 267 - - PAGE 262 -
